title: Bread and Pastry Bounce
hook: Sort the structure before you bounce the rhyme.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: bright 3D bread-and-pastry storybook, golden crusts and soft pastel bakery colors, clean isolated baked goods

creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: family cue -> recall beat -> target -> card-sort gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a marimba dough-bounce followed by one soft ukulele shape answer.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a marimba dough-bounce followed by one soft ukulele shape answer
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Bread and Pastry Bounce a dough-family lesson: yeast bread, laminated pastry, quick bread, tart crust, cake batter and frozen ice cream are separated by structure/leavening instead of all being pretend dough.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child sorts baked goods by how structure forms—yeast gas, steam/layers, chemical leavening, egg foam, crust or freezing.
